composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. creative_direction: Sculpt an ivory otter sliding down one small blue ceramic wave, with its tail curled close to the body. Keep the face calmly confident and the paws gathered beneath the chin. Broad glaze highlights follow the curved wave, while tiny pooling remains at joins. Use warm gray surroundings and a shallow shadow, avoiding splash effects or scenery. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
